summary: No findings. API/action flow is coherent; tests cover repeated add, disabled reset suppression, reset flow, fresh session, and invalid paths/events.
review_report: XR-runtime review: ACCEPT. Read-only review of interaction/session.go, session_test.go, cmd/counter-wasm/main_wasm.go, and main_stub.go found the API/action flow coherent: init replaces the session and returns snapshot; dispatch decodes gobi.Step and returns explicit {error} on invalid/missing steps; Session.Dispatch resolves Node paths, ignores disabled nodes without logging a message, invokes declared event handlers, copies ordered message snapshots, and rejects unsupported effects. Tests cover repeated add, disabled reset suppression, reset flow, fresh session, and invalid paths/events. No findings.
